title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, NFTs, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Coinbase CEO says reopening GENIUS Act is ‘red line,’ slams bank lobbying
summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong warned that reopening the GENIUS Act would cross a “red line,” accusing banks of lobbying Congress to block stablecoin rewards and limit competition.

title: No $90K Bitcoin till next year: BTC futures open interest hits 8-month low
summary: Bitcoin’s resilient basis rate and options data suggest limited downside despite ETF outflows, while BTC waits for a catalyst that can help it reclaim $90,000.

title: Bitmine begins staking ETH, deposits $219M into Ethereum PoS contract
summary: Ethereum treasury firm Bitmine has begun staking Ether after depositing nearly $219 million worth of ETH into Ethereum’s proof-of-stake system.

title: JPMorgan freezes accounts of two stablecoin startups over sanctions concerns: Report
summary: JPMorgan has reportedly frozen accounts linked to Y Combinator–backed stablecoin startups BlindPay and Kontigo after flagging exposure to sanctioned jurisdictions.

title: XRP may trade sideways in 2026 until bullish catalysts emerge: Analysts
summary: The second half of 2026 will provide “more constructive conditions” for XRP to potentially surge, according to Nansen crypto analyst Jake Kennis.

title: Bitcoin saw bear market in 2025, 'decade-long' bull run ahead: Mow
summary: Bitcoin reached new all-time highs in October, yet Jan3 founder Samson Mow has described the year as a “bear market” and anticipates a major bull run ahead.

title: Ethereum's TVL could skyrocket '10X' in 2026: Sharplink CEO
summary: A surge in stablecoins, tokenized RWAs and growing sovereign wealth fund interest could drive a major increase in Ethereum’s TVL in 2026, Sharplink’s co-CEO said.

title: Bitmain slashes ASIC prices amid mining industry turmoil: Report
summary: Discounts and bundle deals were offered to mining operators, as 2025 ends on a bad note for the crypto market and the mining industry.

title: Etheruem’s tokenization role takes focus as Tom Lee outlines bullish outlook
summary: Fundstrat’s head of research said institutional tokenization supports a $7,000–$9,000 Ether price in early 2026 and a longer-term case for $20,000.
